entries.76e10bcace9a9d21: This segment sells products and operates food and beverage businesses in Europe and the Americas. MUJI Europe Limited handles supply, RYOHIN KEIKAKU EUROPE LTD., RYOHIN KEIKAKU FRANCE S.A.S., MUJI ITALIA S.p.A., MUJI Deutschland GmbH, MUJI SPAIN, S.L., MUJI PORTUGAL,LDA, MUJI U.S.A. Limited and MUJI CANADA LIMITED handle sales, and MUJI Finland Oy handles sales and food and beverage sales. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, operating revenue from external customers was ¥42,133 million (up 7.9% year on year), and segment profit was ¥6,922 million (up 25.7%). The company explains that the number of stores fell year on year due to closures of unprofitable stores, while same-store sales grew, and cites that in Europe, profitability improved as unprofitable stores were closed under the structural reforms accompanying the previous year's business restructuring, and that in North America, expanded in-store inventory contributed to same-store sales growth, and closures of unprofitable stores in Canada also contributed to profit improvement. The segment has 558 employees (in addition, an annual average of 475 temporary employees).

entries.95a439bfe0cdc031: This is an operating segment not included in the reportable segments, which the company describes as the Global Sourcing Business. Aimujisi (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd., MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING VIETNAM COMPANY LIMITED, PT. MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING INDONESIA, MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING (CAMBODIA) CO.,LTD. and MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED conduct research and quality control for MUJI products. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, there was no operating revenue from external customers; revenue consisted of intersegment internal operating revenue of ¥1,401 million. Segment profit was ¥73 million, and the segment had 107 employees. This segment supports the product-making side within the group and is not a segment that sells to outside consumers.
entries.a5b7c05036263505: This segment sells products and operates food and beverage businesses in East Asia. MUJI (HONG KONG) CO.,LTD., MUJI (Shanghai) Commercial Co., Ltd. and Taiwan MUJI Co., Ltd. handle sales and food and beverage sales, and MUJI Korea Co.,Ltd. handles sales. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, operating revenue from external customers was ¥222,247 million (up 14.2% year on year), and segment profit was ¥42,794 million (up 20.4%), the second-largest scale after the domestic business. The company cites online sales growth in mainland China, driven by active promotional activities, with daily goods and food leading strong sales, and gross profit improvement from lower cost ratios and restrained price cuts as contributing factors. Taiwan and Hong Kong also posted higher revenue and profit, while Korea recorded higher revenue as same-store sales grew, but profit declined due to the impact of exchange rates. The segment has 6,594 employees (in addition, an annual average of 2,634 temporary employees), the largest of the reportable segments.

Directly operated stores are located in each region from Hokkaido to Kyushu, and the main facilities listed include MUJI Ginza (Chuo-ku, Tokyo).
entries.c8f33d0898bd630c: This segment sells products and operates food and beverage businesses in Southeast Asia and Oceania. MUJI (SINGAPORE) PRIVATE LTD. and MUJI PHILIPPINES CORP. handle sales and food and beverage sales, and MUJI (MALAYSIA) SDN.BHD., MUJI Retail (Thailand) Co.,Ltd., MUJI RETAIL (AUSTRALIA) PTY LTD, Ryohin-Keikaku Reliance India Private Limited and MUJI RETAIL (VIETNAM) LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY handle sales. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, operating revenue from external customers was ¥50,105 million (up 28.0% year on year), the segment with the highest growth rate among the four reportable segments. Segment profit was ¥5,584 million (up 21.4%). The company states that, in addition to expanding stores mainly in Vietnam and Malaysia, same-store sales also recovered from the second quarter onward. The segment has 2,505 employees (in addition, an annual average of 459 temporary employees).

entries.e3fc675c76beb8d0: This category covers the business of selling products through stores in Japan and the internet, and the domestic procurement and logistics business and others. The company itself carries out sales and supply, food and beverage sales and camp ground operation, and MUJI HOUSE Co., Ltd. carries out housing sales. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥470,143 million (up 20.9% from the previous year), the largest of the 4 reportable [[term:segment|segments]]. Segment profit was ¥52,111 million (up 31.2%). As reasons for the increase in revenue, the company cites stronger product appeal, including skin care and daily consumables, continued marketing using SNS and its own app, and improved operational capability such as store operation and inventory management, and states that existing-store sales stayed on a positive trend throughout the year. The number of employees is 2,845 (plus temporary employees averaging 10,635 over the year).
